description: Source code implementing memory dependency analysis for Torch JIT, including classes and functions for managing memory elements, aliasing, and wildcards.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents a memory element with associated value and index, used in alias analysis.

classes.name: MemoryDAG
classes.description: Immutable class representing the memory dependency graph, with methods for alias checks and cache management.

classes.name: MemoryDAGBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing and modifying MemoryDAG instances, including pointer and wildcard management.

methods.name: makePointerToImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation for setting pointer relationships between elements.

methods.name: makeFreshValueImpl
methods.description: Creates a new element representing a fresh alias for a given value.

methods.name: fromIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an element by index from MemoryDAG.

methods.name: mayAlias
methods.description: Checks if two elements may alias in memory.

methods.name: mayContainAlias
methods.description: Checks if an element may contain alias with another element or set of elements.

methods.name: getAllContainedMemoryLocations
methods.description: Returns all memory locations contained within an element, with caching.

methods.name: collectAllContainedMemoryLocations
methods.description: Recursively collects all contained memory locations into a set.

methods.name: setWildcards
methods.description: Sets wildcard values in the memory graph, updating pointers and caches accordingly.

methods.name: unsafeMakeFreshValue
methods.description: Creates a new element for a value without cache considerations.
